title: Residual-based Kaczmarz methods for tensor linear equations with t-product
summary: Tensor linear systems widely arise from high-dimensional data mining and computing, for instance, natural language processing and machine learning. A class of residual-based tensor Kaczmarz method is proposed for tensor linear equations with t-product. Theoretical analyses prove the convergence and give an upper bound of the convergence rate of the proposed method. Furthermore, an accelerated residual-based Kaczmarz method with heavy ball momentum is developed.
